meta.title: Space Colony Defence - combat and economy tables
meta.status: INITIAL PLAYTEST SETTINGS - proposals, not validated balance

simulation.note: Fixed timestep. One tick = 1/60 simulation second. 1x = accumulate real time, 2x = accumulate at double rate, pause = zero steps.
tickOrder: 1 apply queued player commands (place, upgrade, sell, targeting, power) in arrival order
2 scheduled spawns that are due, then descendant releases that are due (both respect caps)
3 support timers: Mira shield pulses, Patchling heal pulse (global clock), boss phase checks
5 alien movement in alien-id order; leaks resolved as they happen

grid.note: x 0..19 left to right, y 0..10 top to bottom; one unit = one tile

pads.note: Portal lookout: sees only the entry stretch. A quiet spot for Mira, who needs no range.
Entry corner: first shots; covers the end of the entry stretch and the top of the first descent.
Mouth of the first U: modest short-range cover; good long-range cover.
Inside the first U: sees the descent and the climb; an excellent long-range pad.
PRIME - bottom of the first U: three path stretches within short range.
Below the first U: weak at short range; a perch for long-range Orion.
Above the top bend: weak at short range; a perch for long-range Orion.
PRIME - under the top bend: three path stretches within short range. Opens with Juno.
Command pad: centre of the map; an excellent long-range pad; all three PRIME pads are within Sol's first radius.
Beacon mound: little cover of its own, six pads within Sol's radius. Opens with Sol.
Mouth of the last U: modest short-range cover; good long-range cover.
Inside the last U: sees the last descent and the final climb; an excellent long-range pad.
PRIME - bottom of the last U: the last place to catch groups. Opens with Pip.
Below the last U: weak at short range; fine for long range.
Colony balcony: hardly sees the path - ideal for Mira.
Last line: covers the final climb and the colony approach.

colony.note: Leak damage is removed from shield points first, then health. Health 0 = defeat. Shield above shieldCap (only possible from the Colony Shield power) is trimmed to shieldCap when the wave ends.

combatRules.rangeRule: An alien is in range when the distance from the pad centre to the alien's point on the route is <= range.
damageOrder: flying: Juno blast halved, rounded up
bubble layer absorbs the whole hit

slow.stacking: none - an alien has one slow at a time; a stronger slow replaces it (strength and duration); an equally strong one keeps whichever remaining time is longer; a weaker one is ignored

combatRules.splash: full-radius: every alien whose centre is within splashRadius of the target's position takes the full blast damage; nothing outside the previewed circle is damaged; no falloff
combatRules.buff: an astronaut takes only the single largest buffPct among Sols whose radius reaches its pad; Sol never buffs Sol, Mira or itself; buff strength depends only on Sol's own level

targetingModes.FRONT: the alien in range that is furthest along the route (default for every attacking class)
targetingModes.FAST: the alien in range with the highest current speed; ties -> FRONT
targetingModes.CROWD: the alien in range with the most aliens inside the blast radius around it; ties -> FRONT
targetingModes.STRONG: the alien in range with the highest current health; ties -> FRONT (Orion from level 3)

combatRules.pipTargetRule: Within its chosen mode Pip first prefers aliens that are not currently slowed.

sell.covers: purchase price plus all paid upgrades

rounding.patchlingHeal: floor(amount * hpMult + 0.5), never above maximum health
rounding.cometBurst: ceil(maxHealth * pct / 100), removed directly from health

combatRules.attackTiming: An attacker fires on the first tick on which its timer is ready and a target is in range, then waits one attack period. All timers are ready at wave start. Upgrading keeps the timer. A newly placed attacker is ready at once; a newly placed Mira starts a full recharge.
combatRules.waveComplete: The schedule is exhausted, no descendant release is queued, and no alien is active.

economy.note: Credits come only from defeated aliens and successful normal learning activities. Meteor challenges award powers, never credits.

blob.name: Moon Blob
blob.cue: Round wobbling jelly; slow squash-and-stretch walk.

mite.name: Meteor Mite
mite.traitRule: No special rule: simply fast and fragile.
mite.cue: Small pointed rock with legs; quick scurry with a dust trail.

shell.name: Shellback
shell.traitRule: Armour 4: every hit loses 4 damage, but always does at least 1.
shell.cue: Wide domed shell; slow heavy plod; hits make a 'clonk' spark.

swarm.name: Bubble Swarm
swarm.traitRule: Always arrives as a tight cluster of small bubbles (each bubble is one alien).
swarm.cue: Tiny bobbing bubbles in a bunch; bouncy hop.

flutter.name: Orbit Flutter
flutter.traitRule: Flying: follows the same route; Juno's blast does half damage to it (rounded up).
flutter.cue: Winged disc with a shadow on the path below; fluttering bob (visual only).

guard.name: Bubble Guard
guard.traitRule: Four bubble layers: each layer absorbs one whole hit of any size, then pops. Layers never come back. Slows still apply.
guard.cue: Alien inside four nested soap bubbles; a layer pops with each hit.

patch.name: Patchling
patch.traitRule: Healer: on a shared 3-second clock, every OTHER alien within 1.5 tiles of at least one Patchling regains 6 health multiplied by the wave's health multiplier (never above its maximum; being near several Patchlings gives one heal, not several).
patch.cue: Carries a sticking-plaster flag; green sparkle ring on each heal pulse.

slime.name: Split Slime
slime.traitRule: Splitter: when defeated, releases 2 Slimelets at its route position. If it reaches the colony it does not split.
slime.cue: Two-lobed blob with a visible seam; stretches as it oozes.

slimelet.name: Slimelet
slimelet.traitRule: Descendant of Split Slime. Never splits again.

craft.name: Alien Craft
craft.traitRule: Carrier: when defeated, releases its cargo (default 4 Moon Blobs; a wave may name other cargo) at its route position. If it reaches the colony it applies its leak damage and releases nothing.
craft.cue: Toy-like hovering saucer, low over the path; portholes show the passengers.

caps.rule: A scheduled spawn that is due while 48 or more aliens are active waits (never dropped) and is released in schedule order, at most one every 0.25 s, as room appears. A descendant release waits at the parent's defeat position while 60 aliens are active or 24 descendants are alive. Deferred entities keep their identity and bounty; nothing is duplicated or lost. Depth: a Craft's cargo may not contain Crafts or Split Slimes (depth 1); only a boss release may contain Split Slimes, whose Slimelets are depth 2; nothing goes deeper.

frost_pulse.name: Frost Pulse
frost_pulse.effect: Every alien on the field is slowed by 50% for 6 s (bosses 25%). Obeys the normal strongest-slow rule and the 50% cap.
frost_pulse.mouse: Click the power button (or its HUD icon).
frost_pulse.keyboard: Press 1, or Tab to the button and press Enter/Space.

comet_burst.name: Comet Burst
comet_burst.effect: Every alien within 1.5 tiles of the chosen point on the route loses 50% of its MAXIMUM health (bosses 10%), ignoring armour and bubbles. Aliens brought to zero are defeated and pay their normal bounty.
comet_burst.mouse: Click the power button, move the ring (it snaps to the nearest point of the route), click to drop. Right-click or Esc cancels without using the charge.
comet_burst.keyboard: Press 2: the ring starts on the front-most alien. Left/Right arrows slide it along the route in half-tile steps, Enter/Space drops, Esc cancels.

colony_shield.name: Colony Shield
colony_shield.effect: Adds 10 shield points at once. May lift the shield above the normal cap of 10 up to the absolute cap of 20; anything above 10 is trimmed when the wave ends.
colony_shield.keyboard: Press 3, or Tab to the button and press Enter/Space.

powerRules.persistence: Unused charges stay in the run's inventory (they are run resources in the snapshot) until used, defeat, abandon or run completion. They never transfer to another run.
powerRules.usableIn: any wave after the charge is earned (including the boss wave it was earned for)
powerRules.awardMapping: fixed rotation by meteor challenge: Frost Pulse, Comet Burst, Colony Shield, then round again
powerRules.note: Choosing a Comet Burst target pauses the simulation (zero steps) so aiming is untimed. Cooldowns are per wave, so no timer state is ever saved.

endless.generator: pure function of the wave number (no randomness, no seed): every run sees the same endless waves
endless.templateRule: wave n with (n - 50) mod 10 = j uses the groups of authored campaign wave 40 + j for j = 1..9; j = 0 (waves 60, 70, ...) is a boss wave

countMult.formula: min(cap, 1 + perCycle * floor((n - 51) / 10)); group count = ceil(count * countMult), gaps unchanged

bossHp.formula: min(cap, base + perBoss * k) for the k-th endless boss (k = 1 at wave 60); the boss keeps its own phases, speed and leak damage

endless.concurrencyCaps: identical to the campaign caps (60 active, 48 scheduled soft cap, 24 live descendants)
endless.plateau: after the last cap is reached every wave with the same template is identical for ever; nothing grows

badges.name: First Steps
badges.rule: highestCompletedWave >= 1 on any campaign run (awarded in COMPLETE_WAVE).

badges.name: Clank Cracker
badges.rule: COMPLETE_WAVE for campaign wave 20 (same event records next-planet eligibility).

badges.name: Colony Hero
badges.rule: COMPLETE_WAVE for campaign wave 50; committed before the endless offer is shown.

badges.name: Full Crew
badges.rule: A wave-start snapshot (START_WAVE) contains at least one astronaut of each of the six classes.

badges.name: Top Team
badges.rule: A wave-start snapshot contains at least one level-3 astronaut.

badges.name: Safe and Sound
badges.rule: COMPLETE_WAVE for a campaign boss wave (10/20/30/40/50) whose post-wave snapshot health is not lower than the health in that wave's start snapshot.

badges.name: Bright Spark
badges.rule: Lifetime count of SUCCEEDED normal activities (sum of the learning summaries) reaches 10.

badges.name: Brilliant Spark
badges.rule: Lifetime count of SUCCEEDED normal activities reaches 50.

badges.name: All-Rounder
badges.rule: Learning summaries show at least 5 SUCCEEDED activities in each of maths, phonics and spelling.

badges.name: Keep Trying
badges.rule: A slot resolves SUCCEEDED on its second or third attempt.

challenges.name: Blob Parade
challenges.about: Five gentle waves with only Nova on the six starting pads: a first taste, or a quick go.

challenges.name: Wobble Rematch
challenges.about: The team is already at its posts. Two warm-up waves, an optional meteor challenge for a Frost Pulse, then King Wobble.

challenges.name: Bubble Trouble
challenges.about: A ready-made team with one Juno and one Pip. Six waves of swarms, Bubble Guards and groups.

performance.note: Attacks resolve instantly in the simulation; beams, comets and star bursts are pooled render-only effects with fixed lifetimes. When a pool is empty the oldest effect is recycled; simulation outcomes never depend on effects.
